comments.value:
I'm gonna respond here simply for the fact that I'm an autistic individual (specifically asperger's syndrome)
Your main argument is that blender and unity both have bad UIs and that you want VRChat to fix these. Simply put, I, and I'm sure the vast majority of content creators, disagree.
Starting out, I'll try to interpret what you've said,
"2012- 2022, it's out of date by 10 years."
Not sure what you mean with this since both blender has been around since 1994 and that it keeps getting updates, having it latest update around the start of this year. Additionally, blender has updated it's UI a few times in the past updates which has only made it far easier once you're used to it.
"Yet games like W.o.W. More recently Elden ring and 
sandbox games( although primitive in nature) have been doing it  since 2012."
Please don't compare a 3D modelling software to games; UIs are designed for their purpose so games can have quite minimal UIs since they might not need much like with Elden Ring or sandbox games.
"2B: So their coders refuse to update to a modern More Disability-friendly interface.
making it impossible for users  with autism to create amazing avatars( like mine)"
One, coders aren't necessarily the ones responsible for UI design, two, I've seen a number of people who are autistic with no problems making avatars, sometimes better then average.
"Most People don't like using versions of programs that don't match their tech.
so if they have 2020 tech they expect 2020 versions of software."
I'm not sure I fully understand this bit but I'm guessing you're referring to the unity version? If so, yes we're on an older unity version but with reason, it's not that easy to update to the latest release.
"it seems to me That your coding team has the skills to do what blender and unity refuse to do. AND you would most likely get heavy support from the community."
Blender and Unity both have dedicated teams with probably a large number of people and their applications are vastly different from VRChat.
"option 1. you create plug-ins for unity and blender that change the user interface and make it more user-friendly. So users like me can create avatars and rooms..."
This isn't something VRChat should do but rather the community. If you so want this then make it yourself and maybe you'll find others like you but for the majority of content creators, there's no real need. Also how do you want it made more user-friendly?
"You make your own version of avatar and world creation:
Then allow exportation into different file formats."
The current method for making avatars is easily done with Unity as it get exported as a asset bundle to be loaded in game.
"( I'D recommend inside VR Chat, You  would get a lot more support, but I don't even know if that's plausible to create a creators room with exports and imports, and pen type inputs)"
Neos did this, it works for sure but is, to me, less user-friendly then just using Unity. No to mention what it would require to implement.
"2A.  with your team's coding skills
You could make it an independent program modifying open sources codes
and make a 3D ART Creation and modeling software That is way easier to use."
Again, Blender have people who are much more specific to making a modelling application whereas VRChat have people who work on game development, these are not at all the same.
"3: can anyone actually give me a code, to change the blender  and unity interface, so its actually usable for creating vr chat content?"
What do you actually want changed, there are many different plugins and editor tools that can help but not too many that drastically change the UI but do ask around you might find something.
I ranted a bit but oh well.
TLDR:
VRChat isn't going to make a whole new application or just fix the UI from Blender and/or Unity as they work for most people just fine.
Additionally being autistic doesn't automatically make it harder like in my case, it's easier.
If you want a new UI for Blender or Unity, then make it yourself or find individuals that think the same way.

You can't open with stating point one as fact without saying what you mean by that. What is disability unfriendly about blender's UI. What is unintuitive about blender's UI. And most important you basically just said "Make it better" but didn't say how or what specifically would make it better.
Also if you want to give examples of good UI in games, you should use games with lots of complexity on the magnitude of Blender or Unity.
